chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Ismāʿīl ibn Jābir, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the time of maghrib. He said: “It is what lies between the setting of the sun and the disappearance of the twilight.”

key_terms.الشَّفَقِ: the twilight glow that remains after sunset
key_terms.الشَّمْسِ: the sun, whose setting marks the beginning of maghrib time
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib salat (prayer), performed after sunset
key_terms.غُرُوبِ: the setting or disappearance of the sun below the horizon
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed time or legal period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the time of maghrib salat (prayer) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the time of maghrib salat (prayer) as extending from sunset until the disappearance of the twilight. It is a jurisprudential report concerning the prescribed time of worship and helps clarify the limits of the prayer time.
